name: Jean-Baptiste Waring
title: Postdoctoral Fellow
thesis: Compilation, routing, and noise-aware optimization for near-term quantum processors
bio: Jean-Baptiste Waring is a postdoctoral fellow at LECS, working on compilation flows and error-aware optimisation for noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) processors. Recent contributions include XGSwap (gradient-boosted swap insertion for routing), noise-aware utility optimisation, and dynamic-circuit experiments on CHSH inequality violations.
